Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 GTA 6 is still undergoing changes despite releasing next month, Rockstar boss says: "The game is never completely settled" News By Anthony McGlynn Published 16 October 2026 There are a lot of moving parts When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here's how it works . (Image credit: Rockstar Games) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter We might be getting GTA 6 in November, but that doesn't necessarily mean the game is finished. In fact, games of that scale are never really done; they're just shoved into the world and updated in real time. Rockstar isn't shy about this, openly admitting that alterations are still underway on the blockbuster release. This comes from Jason Schreier of Bloomberg, who put together a report on the huge release. In a YouTube video expanding on his reporting, he mentioned that leadership told him there weren't any major reasons the game kept getting delayed; it simply wasn't ready yet. All the disparate parts weren't coalescing the way anyone wanted, and so on. He provides a quote from Phil Hooker, Rockstar's director of technology, to support this point. "The game is never completely settled," Hooker says. Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: Why Grand Theft Auto VI Took 8+ Years to Make - YouTube Watch On "We never have an exact blueprint," he continues. "Even within the last few months, we've changed things." That may sound somewhat drastic, but it's very normal in the industry, even outside releases of the scale of a new Grand Theft Auto. Devs are frequently tinkering and making adjustments right up to launch day, and then immediately thereafter, hence Day One patches and the like. You may like Parts of GTA 6 are "a bit outdated and weird," says former Rockstar dev Another GTA 6 delay "would not" shock a former GTA 5 dev who says it wouldn't "hurt" Rockstar at all GTA 6 "will be released on time," Rockstar North co-lead says Modern games are living documents, and with the sheer amount going on in GTA 6, I can only imagine all the minute adjustments happening right now. The 13-year gap since the last one has created unprecedented attention and expectation. Rockstar has claimed literal drones have floated around the studio's windows, hoping to catch a glimpse of Leonida. We'll all get to see it in motion come November 19, good, bad, or indifferent. I'm sure it'll have been worth the wait.
